trials.name: circular axial mixing
trials.hypothesis: Adds a learned full-width circular convolution along x and full-height along y, as a residual after the 1x1 stem. Each cell can then learn to pull in target information from any circular offset, undoing the roll, before the local 3x3 convolutions and the footprint pooling. It uses the default recipe, so the effect of the architecture alone is clear. Refuted if dev success stays near 0 and the agent still presses DONE straight away.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
AX = 24
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, mid, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(X)
        self.Y = int(Y)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(c, mid, 1)
        self.cx = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (1, self.X))
        self.cy = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (self.Y, 1))

    def forward(self, s):
        p = F.relu(self.red(s))
        X, Y = self.X, self.Y
        px = F.pad(p, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        py = F.pad(p, (0, 0, Y // 2, Y - 1 - Y // 2), mode='circular')
        return F.relu(self.cx(px) + self.cy(py))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.axial = AxialMix(COL, AX, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        s = s + self.axial(s)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class RelAttn(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.dh = d // heads
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(heads, Y * X))
        ys = torch.arange(Y).repeat_interleave(X)
        xs = torch.arange(X).repeat(Y)
        idx = ((ys[None, :] - ys[:, None]) % Y) * X + ((xs[None, :] - xs[:, None]) % X)
        self.register_buffer('idx', idx)

    def forward(self, t):
        B, N, d = t.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(t).view(B, N, 3, self.h, self.dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        att = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(self.dh)
        att = att + self.bias[:, self.idx].unsqueeze(0)
        att = torch.softmax(att, dim=-1)
        out = torch.matmul(att, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, d)
        return self.o(out)


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, ff, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.attn = RelAttn(d, heads, Y, X)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(ff, d))

    def forward(self, t):
        t = t + self.attn(self.n1(t))
        t = t + self.ff(self.n2(t))
        return t


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, D, 1))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF, self.Y, self.X) for _ in range(2)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        s = self.stem(obs)
        t = s.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.norm(t)
        f = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, self.Y, self.X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 48
COL = 48
AX = 24
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, mid, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(X)
        self.Y = int(Y)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(c, mid, 1)
        self.cx = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (1, self.X))
        self.cy = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (self.Y, 1))

    def forward(self, s):
        p = F.relu(self.red(s))
        X, Y = self.X, self.Y
        px = F.pad(p, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        py = F.pad(p, (0, 0, Y // 2, Y - 1 - Y // 2), mode='circular')
        return F.relu(self.cx(px) + self.cy(py))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        Z = self.Z
        self.bconv = nn.Conv2d(Z + 2, STEM, 1)
        self.tconv = nn.Conv2d(3 * Z + 1, STEM, (1, self.X))
        self.stem2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)
        self.axial = AxialMix(COL, AX, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z, X = self.Z, self.X
        b = torch.cat([obs[:, :Z], obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1], obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3]], dim=1)
        t = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        tp = F.pad(t, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        s = F.relu(self.bconv(b) + self.tconv(tp))
        s = F.relu(self.stem2(s))
        s = s + self.axial(s)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ent_coef": 0.03}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
AX = 24
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, mid, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(X)
        self.Y = int(Y)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(c, mid, 1)
        self.cx = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (1, self.X))
        self.cy = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (self.Y, 1))

    def forward(self, s):
        p = F.relu(self.red(s))
        X, Y = self.X, self.Y
        px = F.pad(p, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        py = F.pad(p, (0, 0, Y // 2, Y - 1 - Y // 2), mode='circular')
        return F.relu(self.cx(px) + self.cy(py))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.axial = AxialMix(COL, AX, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        s = s + self.axial(s)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

STEM = 48
COL = 48
AX = 24
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):

                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, c, mid, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(X)
        self.Y = int(Y)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(c, mid, 1)
        self.cx = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (1, self.X))
        self.cy = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (self.Y, 1))

    def forward(self, s):
        p = F.relu(self.red(s))
        X, Y = self.X, self.Y
        px = F.pad(p, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        py = F.pad(p, (0, 0, Y // 2, Y - 1 - Y // 2), mode='circular')
        return F.relu(self.cx(px) + self.cy(py))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        Z = self.Z
        self.bconv = nn.Conv2d(Z + 2, STEM, 1)
        self.tconv = nn.Conv2d(3 * Z + 1, STEM, (1, self.X))
        self.stem2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)
        self.axial = AxialMix(COL, AX, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z, X = self.Z, self.X
        b = torch.cat([obs[:, :Z], obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1], obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3]], dim=1)
        t = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        tp = F.pad(t, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        s = F.relu(self.bconv(b) + self.tconv(tp))
        s = F.relu(self.stem2(s))
        s = s + self.axial(s)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ent_coef": 0.03, "ppo_epochs": 3}

STEM = 48
COL = 48
AX = 24
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class AxialMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, mid, Y, X):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = int(X)
        self.Y = int(Y)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(c, mid, 1)
        self.cx = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (1, self.X))
        self.cy = nn.Conv2d(mid, c, (self.Y, 1))

    def forward(self, s):
        p = F.relu(self.red(s))
        X, Y = self.X, self.Y
        px = F.pad(p, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        py = F.pad(p, (0, 0, Y // 2, Y - 1 - Y // 2), mode='circular')
        return F.relu(self.cx(px) + self.cy(py))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        Z = self.Z
        self.bconv = nn.Conv2d(Z + 2, STEM, 1)
        self.tconv = nn.Conv2d(3 * Z + 1, STEM, (1, self.X))
        self.stem2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1)
        self.axial = AxialMix(COL, AX, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z, X = self.Z, self.X
        b = torch.cat([obs[:, :Z], obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1], obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3]], dim=1)
        t = torch.cat([obs[:, Z:4 * Z], obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2]], dim=1)
        tp = F.pad(t, (X // 2, X - 1 - X // 2, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        s = F.relu(self.bconv(b) + self.tconv(tp))
        s = F.relu(self.stem2(s))
        s = s + self.axial(s)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ent_coef": 0.03, "ppo_epochs": 2}

STEM = 48
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 24


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))

        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.X = int(spec.X)

        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z, X = self.Z, self.X
        b = torch.cat([obs[:, :Z], obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1], obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3]], dim=1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

COL = 48
WIDTH = 40

HID = 24

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):

            else:

                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)

        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network collapsed to pressing DONE straight away (0 placements, 0.000 dev). A likely reason is the hidden rule: the target, missing, extra and target-height channels are rolled 4 columns along x, wrapping around, but the build channels are not. The starting network uses 1x1 and 3x3 convolutions, which see about 2 cells either side, so it never sees a cell's build state next to the target state that belongs to it. Every placement then looks like it has negative expected reward, and DONE (reward 0) wins. The fix is to give the network learned global mixing that is circular along each axis, so it can learn the realignment itself. This uses no hand-coded shift, so the same idea should carry over to other grid sizes and other shift rules. A second issue is that the default budget allows only about 32 PPO updates, so smaller rollout batches may help. This round tests: circular axial mixing (A), A with a recipe giving more updates (B), and attention with a learned circular relative-position bias (C).
analyses.2: Only r1c1 (circular axial mixing, default recipe) got past the DONE collapse, scoring 0.094 (0.037 and 0.150 across its two seeds). The same network with smaller, more frequent updates (r1c2) and the relative-bias attention trunk (r1c3) both collapsed to pressing DONE at once. With only 2 seeds, r1c1 vs r1c2 may partly be seed luck. Collapse looks like the main failure: random placements earn negative reward, so DONE wins early. r1c1 only started placing after 50% of training. In r1c1's traces the agent places correct cells (IoU 0.69, almost no extra cells) but stops early and misses higher layers. So it learns the roll. A cleaner fix is to realign the target before any channel mixing. The stem currently mixes the unshifted build channels with the shifted target channels at the same cell. This round runs a 2x2 factorial against r1c1: a split stem with circular realignment of the target channels, higher entropy, and both together.
analyses.3: The split realign stem plus entropy 0.03 is the best so far (0.208; seeds 0.223 and 0.193). Each change alone scored 0.108 to 0.148. Together they beat r1c1 (0.094) by more than the seed spread, so both changes look useful. Two runs collapsed to pressing DONE straight away: the 128-env, 3-epoch run and the transformer run, both at entropy 0.01. The higher entropy bonus guards against this. In r2c3, training success was still rising steeply at the end (0.013 at 75%, 0.142 at 100%), so sample count looks like the main limit. The traces point to two other faults: the agent stops too early and leaves columns unbuilt, and it misplaces bricks on upper layers where an overhang needs empty cells under it. Mean IoU is high at about 0.82. This round tests extra samples: fewer PPO epochs, and a leaner network so the flops ratio r falls from 1.52 to about 1.04. It also tests whether the axial block earns its compute.
analyses.4: Two changes clearly helped. First, a learned full-width circular (1,X) convolution on the target-side channels undoes the 4-column roll; alone it lifted dev success from 0 to 0.21. Second, more training samples helped far more than anything else. Removing the axial block brought r down from 1.52 to 1.05, and with 4 PPO epochs dev success rose to 0.50. Cutting to 2 epochs then gave 0.785, with both seeds close (0.81 and 0.76). The training curve was still rising at the end (0.73). Dev readouts show IoU 0.97 and exact builds on both diagnostic designs, so the remaining errors are small. Both data-heavy trials ran about 70 seconds, so time is not a constraint. An entropy bonus of 0.03 prevented collapse to pressing DONE straight away; 128 envs with entropy 0.01 collapsed. This last round keeps the r3c3 network and uses ppo_epochs 1, giving about 405k steps and about 99 updates. The three candidates differ in how they make up for using each sample once: plain, more minibatches, or a higher learning rate.
